## Context / Problem
Advanced bridge/reconciler, audit, LLM/review, workflow, identity, and gate commands mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch. Their current `--help` behavior is also the source of the 21 unsafe/incomplete top-level help forms. The grammar must become reusable without importing optional runtimes.

## Approach
Inventory every registered advanced grammar in `src/rebar/_cli/`, standalone verification/auth command modules, and the reconciler request CLI. For each family:

1. Extract existing argparse construction into the S2a side-effect-free factory contract; migrate manual nested dispatch where required.
2. Switch the selected runtime handler to the same factory in the same change.
3. Keep parser factories in lean modules: no Pydantic AI/provider, FastAPI/UI, Jira transport, workflow executor, metrics, tracing, or other optional runtime imports.
4. Reuse argument-definition helpers between canonical nested bridge forms and `bridge-fsck`, `bridge-probe`, `jira-onboard`, and hidden `bridge-status`; only `prog`, visibility, and replacement epilog differ.
5. Preserve handler-owned nested command selection, lean modes, backend/mode selection timing, diagnostics, streams, and exit codes. Optional capability enforcement remains S4 and never occurs during parser construction.
6. Register all parser references and make every visible advanced route generation-ready, without changing top-level help routing yet.

Families include bridge and reconcile, audit, prompt/criteria/LLM setup, review/scan/explain/sign operations, workflow, config/identity verification/trusted-environment/remote-certificate commands, and enrichment.

## Compatibility and Rollback
No top-level help cutover occurs here. Current execution behavior remains invariant. The later help normalization is approved, but generated bytes do not become authoritative until S2d. Each family reverts with its handler switch; no stored data changes.

## Testing
Use parser unit matrices plus real subprocess/interface tests for nested selection, help-safe parser construction, aliases, lean modes, failures, streams, and exit codes. Install import blockers for every heavy optional module and use negative controls that prove selected execution still imports what its mode actually requires.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every registered advanced command and nested subcommand runtime uses one S2a parser factory; no inline/manual duplicate grammar remains.
- [ ] Canonical and compatibility bridge spellings share argument-definition helpers while retaining approved `prog`, replacement, visibility, and historical usage behavior.
- [ ] Parser construction succeeds in the no-extras environment and imports no handler executor, provider, UI, Jira transport, or other optional runtime.
- [ ] Production-path tests show no unapproved delta in nested selection, accepted/rejected argv, diagnostics, streams, exit codes, or lean-mode availability.
- [ ] Every advanced route has a valid factory reference and is ready for deterministic S2d generation.
